sources.label: morphe patches for kakaotalk/dcinside
sources.author: Ample
patch_list: Add notification shortcut
Adds a notification shortcut button above quick write in the post list.
Add settings
Adds a Morphe settings entry to the DCInside settings screen.
Add settings resources
Adds Morphe settings resources to the app.
Adjust image download menu
Moves the image download menu buttons upward by adding bottom padding.
Bypass getText
Bypasses the integrity check for getText.
Change package name
Appends ".revanced" to the package name by default. For DCinside only
Custom branding
Customize app branding (name and icon)
Dimens Patch
reassigns ad_minimum_height to 0dp to remove ads from the app.
Disable ad controller
Disables the ad controller that manages ads in the app.
Disable Comment Ad
Disables the comment ad in the app.
Disable DCCon loading
Adds settings to block DCCon image loading in posts and replies.
Disable Image Ad
Disables the image ad in the app.
Disable update check
Disables the app's update check.
Filter recently viewed posts by gallery
Adds a gallery filter below the recently viewed posts filters, which narrows the list down to the posts of a single gallery.
Gallery watch mode
Keeps gallery auto-refresh active, highlights newly arrived posts, and optionally alerts with sound or vibration while the gallery is open.
Hide DC official notices
Hides official DCInside operator notices from gallery notice lists.
Hide home components
Adds settings to hide selected DCInside home screen components.
Hide Main Ad
Hides the main ad in the app.
Hide mini gallery cover image
Adds a setting to hide the mini gallery cover image above post lists.
Hide post list page indicators
Adds a setting to hide the Page N indicators between pages in post lists.
Register settings activity
Registers the Morphe settings activity in the app manifest.
Render big DCCon as normal size
Adds a setting to render big DCCon at normal DCCon size.
Restore old post icons
Adds a setting to restore DCInside 4.7.x post list and read footer icons.
Show author identifier

Adds options to show the author identifier next to the nickname in posts, post lists, comments, and the recently-viewed posts list. The recently-viewed list only shows it for posts opened after this patch is installed.
Show live best on home
Shows real-time best posts instead of recommended posts on the home screen.
Spoof Signature
Spoofs the app signature to bypass integrity checks.
